title: Influential coordinate count bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{-1,1\\}$ be a Boolean function. For a real threshold $\\tau>0$, let $S$ be the coordinates whose influence is at least $\\tau$. Then $|S|\\leq I/\\tau$, where $I$ is the total influence of the associated real-valued function.
